title: French Pisto Tart
description: A French-inspired tart filled with a rich pisto sauce and gooey cheese.

ingredients.name: gooey cheese
ingredients.notes: such as brie or goat cheese

instructions: Roll out the puff pastry and place it in a tart pan.
Brush the crust with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the pisto sauce over the crust, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the pisto sauce with the cooked paella rice and gooey cheese.
Fold the edges of the crust up over the filling to form a crust.
Bake the tart for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
